Hospital reception: right wrist pain after yesterday fall, fingertip numbness since this morning and perceived worsening; receptionist cannot diagnose or guarantee admission, notes precede work concerns, staff assess referral/appointment/documents.

Police wallet hand-in: twenty minutes is approximate, crossing-side location shown by finder, contents/cards untouched and unphotographed, officer explains finder rights/contact sharing before learner records preferences; no promise of private number protection is invented.

Factory shoe purchase: protective toe cap plus slip-resistant soles, 26cm is learner requirement not stock confirmation; mall tenancy/contact listing conditional, ask company if supplier unavailable, do not buy on appearance alone.

Vegetable shelf labels: 100g unit price differs from 300g bag, neighboring origin differs, actual bag price/weight checked before checkout, learner waits with one bag and chooses count after verification; no amount invented.

Ramen seating: two adjacent seats and suitcase storage remain unconfirmed, keep aisle/entry clear, order only after arrangements, assist friend reading menu and check adjustability per dish, do not promise non-spicy modification.

Hypothetical izakaya: colleague arrival unconfirmed and may cancel; learner ultimately enters as two, third seat not held, 300yen/person and 600yen/two plus food/drink, single payer; fees are simulation terms not real-store policy certification.

Cooler loan return: lid/box present but original strap at home; deadline day after tomorrow, return tomorrow with original strap and slip, compare IDs/condition, take box back today, deposit settlement conditional on slip not guaranteed refund.

Commuter shoes: waterproof differs from slip resistance; no ice guarantee; current foot slides downhill, compare fastening/shape and heel/toe room with thick winter socks before choosing, increasing size not automatic fix.

Bowling beginners: both wear socks, right rental shoe toe area tight only, game not started; ask practice/turn handling, both wait, never enter lane for unreturned ball, staff explain safe range before start.

Salary bank: ask full bank name/existing-account acceptance/payroll deadline; only residence card plus employer information confirmed, sufficiency pending; screening and same-day completion unpromised, ask before signing.

Missing bicycle update: supermarket manager moved bicycle to storage, blurry silver/black-basket photo is candidate only, number later matches registration, tomorrow collection distinct from location confirmation today; ask handler about follow-up without inventing withdrawal procedure.

Postal missed delivery: address match alone does not identify addressee; husband named, same household does not ensure counter collection, check requirements/storage deadline/available delivery slots, keep husband recipient separate from requester contact field.

Payroll bank branch: apparent example branch not confirmed requirement, ask employer first; residence card updated while phone bill old address; disclose discrepancy, ask required/missing documents list, application acceptance does not establish account opened.

Fish-free soup: vegetable-stock name not proof of ingredients, bonito extract is fish-derived, only fish avoidance currently stated; same-factory warning separate from ingredients, extent of avoidance not inferred allergy/religion, manufacturer clarification and store photo rules remain pending.

Fog walk: mapped path is out-and-back not loop, 20minute intention revised to turn around after about10minutes, no distant viewpoint, stay within sign visibility and unaided-return range, end early if conditions worsen; invented park routing not real-world route claim.

Fictional Kitami train search: reverse direction and last-week date corrected; penultimate20:10,last21:05,no transfer;19:40finish+20minwalk=20:00arrival,10min buffer; candidates not guaranteed service, seek employer ride if delayed rather than run.

Post-employment health-insurance consultation: old job ended last month, new job started but insurance procedure/start unconfirmed; bring eligibility-loss document and separate exit/loss/joining dates, request consultation not immediate enrollment; no gap/overlap inference.

Fictional Bibai seminar: same-name site in wrong town, organizer address and participant north entrance distinct from main door;09:40+15min=09:55,5min margin before10:00, estimate not arrival guarantee, carry diagram to ask.

School income certificates: fiscal certificate year differs from income year, previous city residence relevant to issuing jurisdiction; school needs both spouses, verify separately including proxy conditions before application; no invented statutory dates.

Left-knee consultation: three-day onset, downstairs worse than flat, not right; movement-triggered rather than constant incl work stairs; repeat clinician instructions in own words without feigned understanding, no diagnosis/dosing invented.

Unknown payment-demand message: phone number entered via link but no payment, verification email received and code/payment information unsent; preserve sender/body/times despite fear, stop input/transfer/reply, check service protection and advised consultation route.

Hypothetical checkout: one owned insulated food bag plus exactlyone purchased detergent bag, not two food bags; points card before accepted payment card, verify card support and bag-inclusive total then follow machine prompts until completion; not real-store policy.

Lost bottle: white same-model resemblance not proof, last used rest-area table then passed playground; bag-packing memory uncertain so check bag, share bottom name sticker only with staff, wait for verification before collection.

Delayed train interview: contact interviewer now with unknown arrival marked unknown; online format discussion not confirmed switch, decide directly with interviewer not station staff; no replacement ticket while pending, operator updates and original seller ticket rules checked separately.

Read container-shopping context and all12locale sets: hot-food versus microwave labels distinct, body/lid heating conditions separate, one meal dimensions fit workplace storage, airtight name not sideways leak guarantee, check transport requirements.

Read low-battery park meeting context and all12locale sets: jointly confirmed entrance name/board, watches matched before battery dies, meet3:00, wait10minutes at same place without wandering and missing each other; check current park guidance.

Read fictional Ishikari timetable arithmetic and all12locale sets: deadline10:15;9:00bus→9:20+walk10→9:30 wait25→9:55train→10:25+walk20→10:45 fails;8:30bus→8:50+walk10→9:00 wait10→9:10train→9:40+walk20→10:00 leaves15minutes; timetable plan not guaranteed actual route.

Read ventilation-fan housing context and all12locale sets: management contact differs from rent recipient, fault photos/time and contract, repairs not automatically reimbursable, check use with manager not appearance, separate repair request/cost responsibility without promising payment.

Read fictional hospital translated-note context and all12locale sets: separate original mother-tongue note/Japanese line, clinician questions patient to distinguish pain/fatigue, incorrect Oct1 13:00 corrected to Oct2 01:00 during overnight Oct1–2 shift, no diagnosis from translation.

Read parked-car open-window context and all12locale sets: morning parking but vague closing memory, bag present yet contents unchecked so nothing-missing not established, manager uncontacted, ask staff about monitoring records without demanding third-party access, current safety separately.

Read missing-page dispatch context and all12locale sets: sealed but not handed over five-page packet currently1,2,4,5; reopen to add3 and order1–5, reply sheet separate enclosure not sixth document page, new envelope and one complete shipment.

Read simulated shared travel reimbursement context and all12locale sets: accommodation12000yen split equally means6000own share to confirm, unpaid separate reservation excluded until payer decided, current companion own message/account versus another person saved prior-trip recipient.

Read detergent refill context and all12locale sets: similar color not same use, photo dishwashing versus selected other-purpose pack, match product name/use/manufacturer current-bottle compatibility, remaining contents checked at home, no mixing types just to fill quantity, clarify before buying.

changes.sourceJa: 診察で動かし方の説明を受けたら自分の言葉で復唱し、理解が合うか確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
